protocol.claim_scope: importance-accounting plumbing and bounded search; exact discovery remains a separate algorithmic metric
protocol.inference_semantics: product-path Feynman-Kac target; raw provider response and deterministic hole selection are auxiliary kernels and cancel; final marginal is stage-4 target
protocol.proposal: q(y|S,x,h)=(1-epsilon) empirical_uniform(four totalized shortlist slots) + epsilon Uniform(complete finite grammar)
protocol.slot_totalization: malformed, missing, out-of-catalog, explicit no-op, and whole-response failures map to the current program; duplicates retain multiplicity; no retry/backfill
